## Description

Reviews an IMPLEMENTED UI (prototype or shipped screens) against the project's design SSOT and user journeys, and drives remediation of the issues found. Covers: design-system conformance (philosophy, principles, guidelines, color system, standard icons, standard components, standard screens), interaction affordances in tables and data grids (pressable items that do nothing, or actions with no affordance), user-journey walkthroughs, and an all-agent UI/UX critique session with a shared evidence-based issue log and a gated remediation loop. Use when: reviewing an implemented UI for design conformance, running a UI/UX critique across the agent roster, auditing table/data-grid interaction affordances, or walking an implementation through user journeys.
